sections.markdown:
## C — Graduated Driver License roads, permit restrictions, decals, permits for residents and newcomers, non-driver ID and registries
Knowledge domain: the three Graduated Driver License (GDL) roads to a basic license, the restrictions on permit and probationary drivers, GDL decals and exemptions, the special learner and examination permits, rules for out-of-state and out-of-country drivers, the non-driver ID, and the donor, next-of-kin, voter and hearing-impaired options.

FACT_ID: sec02-F01 | anchor: A01
New Jersey began its Graduated Driver License (GDL) Program in 2001; it phases in privileges for first-time drivers, extends practice time and sets 18 as the minimum age for an unrestricted basic license. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F02 | anchor: A01
Ignoring GDL restrictions can lead to a $100 fine or a suspension of the motorist's driving privilege. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-F03 | anchor: A02
GDL Option A, the early bird road, begins with a special learner permit at age 16 or older, signed parent or guardian consent, and enrollment in an approved behind-the-wheel training course. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F04 | anchor: A02
On Option A an approved instructor buys the permit, the applicant must pass the knowledge and vision tests, and the MVC validates the permit only once the training course is complete. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F05 | anchor: A02
Option A supervised practice lasts at least six months and must total at least 50 driving hours, 10 of them in darkness, with red GDL decals on the vehicle. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F06 | anchor: A02
A parent, guardian or supervising driver fills out a Certification of Supervised Driving form, and the applicant hands it in at the time of licensing. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F07 | anchor: A02
The Option A probationary license requires six months of supervised driving without suspensions or postponements, a passed MVC road test, and an age of at least 17. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F08 | anchor: A02
Option A then requires at least one year of unsupervised driving under probationary restrictions, and the basic license comes at age 18 or older. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F09 | anchor: A02
A permit may not be used for practice driving until an MVC Driver Testing Center has validated it. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F10 | anchor: A03
GDL Option B, the young adult road, begins with an examination permit at age 17 or older after passing the knowledge and vision tests, with parent or guardian consent if under 18. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F11 | anchor: A03
Option B also requires at least six months of supervised practice with at least 50 hours, 10 of them after dark, followed by a passed road test. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F12 | anchor: A03
Option B ends with the basic license at age 18 or older after one year of unsupervised driving under probationary restrictions. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F13 | anchor: A04
GDL Option C, the adult road, begins with an examination permit at age 21 or older after passing the knowledge and vision tests. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-F14 | anchor: A04
Option C requires at least three months of supervised practice with no suspensions or postponements before the road test, then one year of unsupervised driving before the basic license. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-F15 | anchor: A05
Special learner permit, examination permit and probationary license holders may not drive between 11:01 pm and 5:00 am. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-F16 | anchor: A05
All three GDL stages forbid hand-held and hands-free cell phones and every other electronic device while driving. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-F17 | anchor: A05
A permit holder must have a front-seat supervising driver who is at least 21, holds a valid New Jersey license and has at least three years of driving experience. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-F18 | anchor: A05
A special learner permit holder may carry any parent, guardian or dependent plus one additional passenger. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-F19 | anchor: A05
Examination permit and probationary license holders may carry their dependents plus one other person, unless a parent or guardian is riding along. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-F20 | anchor: A05
The GDL driver and every passenger must wear seat belts, and the decals must be displayed on the license plates. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-F21 | anchor: A05
When an examination permit or probationary license holder is 21 or older, the hour, passenger and decal restrictions no longer apply. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-F22 | anchor: A06
GDL drivers under 21 put one red reflective decal on the top left corner of the rear license plate and one on the top left corner of the front plate. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F23 | anchor: A06
Two removable decals come with the permit for a $4 fee, and extra pairs cost $4 at any MVC Licensing Center. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F24 | anchor: A06
A permit or probationary driver under 21 may drive during the prohibited hours for work or religious reasons only while carrying a signed certification on the employer's or religious institution's official letterhead. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F25 | anchor: A06
If a student driver commits a traffic offense, both the student and the instructor or adult supervising driver are held responsible. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F26 | anchor: A06
After the standard 12-month probationary period, the driver must visit a Licensing Center to upgrade to a basic license, or the probationary restrictions keep applying and can be enforced by police. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F27 | anchor: A06
The approved course behind a special learner permit is six full hours of behind-the-wheel teaching in a car with dual controls, and time spent at the MVC buying the permit or testing does not count. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F28 | anchor: A06
The instructor buys the special learner permit, and it stays valid for two years. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F29 | anchor: A07
The instructor can purchase the special learner permit once the applicant has filled out the form and supplied 6 points of ID, proof of home address and proof of Social Security number. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F30 | anchor: A07
After finishing the training course and before practicing, the special learner permit holder must get the permit validated at a Licensing Center that has a Driver Testing Center. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F31 | anchor: A07
A New Jersey resident aged 17 or older who is not suspended can get an examination permit, which needs neither student status nor an instructor. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F32 | anchor: A07
Knowledge test and vision screening results are good for two years. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F33 | anchor: A07
A driver examination permit is required even if the motorist already holds a valid license from another state. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F34 | anchor: A08
Drivers arriving from another state must purchase a New Jersey examination permit within 60 days after becoming permanent residents, or when the old license expires if that happens first. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-F35 | anchor: A08
Out-of-state drivers under 18 who move to New Jersey fall under the GDL Program. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-F36 | anchor: A08
Out-of-state applicants must pass a vision screening, but the knowledge and road tests are waived with a valid non-probationary license or certified driver abstract from any state, the District of Columbia or a US territory. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-F37 | anchor: A09
Visitors with a foreign license should carry an International Driving Permit (IDP) or an acceptable English translation, and non-citizens must get the IDP in their own country before traveling. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-F38 | anchor: A09
An IDP is an official document but can never replace a driver license; it only adds identification and helps across language barriers. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-F39 | anchor: A09
Anyone aged 14 or older without a valid driver license may apply for a non-driver ID card, which must be given up when the person receives a New Jersey driver license. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-F40 | anchor: A09
Answering yes to organ donation at an MVC Licensing Center puts the words organ donor on your license. [A09]
Source: [A09 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-F41 | anchor: A10
The Next-of-Kin Registry (Sara's Law) lets people aged 14 or older store emergency contacts with the MVC, used only by police to reach them after a crash leaves the person unable to communicate. [A10]
Source: [A10 -> pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-F42 | anchor: A11
Under the National Voter Registration Act, motor vehicle offices must offer voter registration to anyone applying for or renewing a license or ID, or changing an address. [A11]
Source: [A11 -> pdf-0026]

Misconceptions: turning eighteen does not end probationary restrictions by itself, because the driver must visit a Licensing Center to upgrade; hands-free phones are banned for GDL drivers, not just hand-held ones; a license from another state does not remove the need for a New Jersey examination permit; an International Driving Permit is not a license.
Mnemonics: the three GDL roads are Early bird, Young adult and Adult, starting at ages sixteen, seventeen and twenty-one; the curfew starts one minute after eleven at night and ends at five in the morning.
Glossary: GDL means the Graduated Driver License Program; special learner permit means the permit bought by a driving-school instructor for a student in a behind-the-wheel course; examination permit means the permit for applicants who practice with a supervising driver and no instructor; probationary license means the restricted license held for a year before the basic license; supervising driver means an adult who meets the age, license and experience rules.
Dynamic facts: decal prices, fines, phone numbers and online services can change and are isolated as dynamic; confirm them on the MVC website.
